description: Versioned provenance for code extracted out of src/recommendation/ into packages/. One batch per extraction PR, and each batch keeps its own immutable baseline commit, its source -> destination pairs and the identity policy those pairs must satisfy. A later PR APPENDS a batch; a merged batch is never rewritten, so PR 2's baseline cannot drift when PR 3 or PR 4 is measured.

batches.description: Step 4B PR 2: the pure candidates modules, the Engine 1 compatibility tree and the pure half of filtering moved into packages/recommendation-core/src/, leaving identity re-export shims at the old paths. Nothing here is a rewrite: each destination is the same bytes as the source at the baseline.

characterization.capture_commit_subject: test(core): freeze the PR 2 surface before anything moves

batches.description: Step 4B PR 3: the pure Engine 3 assembly stage moved into packages/recommendation-core/src/assembly/, leaving identity re-export shims at the old paths. Its only intra-tree dependencies (../candidates/*, ../filtering/*) already live in the core package, so every relative specifier resolves unchanged from the destination: nothing here is a rewrite.

characterization.capture_commit_subject: test(core): freeze the assembly surface before anything moves

batches.description: Step 4B PR 4: the Engine 5a ranking stage moved into packages/recommendation-core/src/ranking/ - the barrel plus its three stage modules (ranking, diverse top-set selection and archetype selection) - leaving identity re-export shims at the old paths. Its only intra-tree dependencies (../assembly, ../candidates/errors) already live in the core package, so every relative specifier resolves unchanged from the destination: nothing here is a rewrite.

characterization.capture_commit_subject: test(core): freeze the ranking surface before anything moves

batches.description: Step 4B PR 5: the Engine 2D retention stage moved into packages/recommendation-core/src/retention/ - the barrel plus its four stage modules (per-role retention, the budget floor diagnostic, the E2 per-role price targets and the E6 iGPU eligibility set) - leaving identity re-export shims at the old paths. Its whole dependency graph (../candidates/{select,roles,errors}, ../filtering/filter, ../assembly/prices) already lives in the core package, so all 15 relative specifiers resolve unchanged from the destination: nothing here is a rewrite. Four contract suites moved with the modules; retain.test.js stays in the runtime suite because it imports ../scoring/candidate-score, which has not been extracted yet.

characterization.capture_commit_subject: test(core): freeze the retention surface before anything moves

batches.description: Step 4B PR 6: the pure half of Engine 4 scoring moved into packages/recommendation-core/src/scoring/ - the Decision 3(a) configuration validator, the Decision 37 use-case vocabulary, and the STEP 1-3 effective/candidate/build score modules - leaving identity re-export shims at the old paths. Their whole dependency graph (../candidates/{errors,roles}, ../assembly/assemble, ./effective-score) already lives in the core package, so all 13 relative specifiers resolve unchanged from the destination: nothing here is a rewrite. The mixed runtime barrel (scoring/index.js) and its two SQL loaders stay in the runtime tree untouched, and a hand-written 14-key core barrel publishes only the pure surface. Five scoring contract suites moved with the modules, and the deferred retain.test.js moved too: its single scoring import (../scoring/candidate-score) is now a core module.

characterization.capture_commit_subject: test(core): freeze the scoring surface before anything moves

batches.description: Step 4B PR 7: the four pure Engine 6 explanation modules (build-facts, explain, reasons, index) and offers/as-of.js moved into packages/recommendation-core/src/explanation/ and packages/recommendation-core/src/offers/, leaving identity re-export shims at the old paths. Two barrel imports were narrowed BEFORE this baseline (../assembly -> ../assembly/assemble, ../ranking -> ../ranking/select-archetypes), so every relative specifier resolves unchanged from the destination: nothing here is a rewrite. offers/select.js and the runtime offers barrel stay in the runtime tree untouched; the core entry point publishes `explanation` and `offers` (the as-of module itself, with no core offers/index.js). Four explanation/as-of suites moved with the modules.

characterization.capture_commit_subject: test(core): freeze the explanation and as-of surface before anything moves

batches.description: Step 5 W1: the Engine 2 stage 1 offer pre-selection query (selectOfferPrices, the single parameterized store_offer query) moved out of src/recommendation/offers/ into packages/recommendation-runtime/src/offers/, leaving an identity re-export shim at the old path. It is database-backed, so it belongs to the runtime package, not the pure core. The move is byte-identical because the import specifiers were made location-independent BEFORE this baseline: commit 'refactor(offers): reach core through the core-entry adapter' added src/recommendation/core-entry.js and rewrote the module's five requires into one '../core-entry' require, so the same bytes resolve the core package root from either depth (the runtime tree answers the same specifier with its own packages/recommendation-runtime/src/core-entry.js). Behaviour is pinned by the L1 suite src/recommendation/offers/select.test.js - the Decision 65 selection tests among them - which needs an injected fake client, and by the DB-free packages/recommendation-runtime/test/offers-select.test.js added in this batch. No characterization fixture is recorded: a module whose whole contract is exercised through an injected client needs no captured surface beyond the suites that already run in CI.
